reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing getScheduleAmount helper that the server's posting, action-sync and preview code already use.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-implemented; the field is a single helper call.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, the layer that shapes API schedule objects.

scope.why: Only the API model, its type and the input types that must exclude the new read-only field are touched.

maintainability.why: The API value follows the app's rule automatically; spreading Omit<..., 'expectedAmount'> over three input signatures is slightly clumsy compared with separate input/output types.
